## 席位核对 · PR #34433 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T18:06Z

**L1 delta · REWORK(1 项,代码)** · 定稿评论 6924699399 所钉 head;对照 L1 ACCEPT 6923728542(@ `4fffca7e`)。只读 delta:`4fffca7e..9224c0c3`,1 个提交,3 个文件,+111/−27。

**已核**:`spelledFen` 先由拼写判断量级,再转换数字,所以计算量只跟文本长度有关。正则 `DECIMAL_SPELLING` 接受 `String(1e21)` 的 `1e+21` 写法。半舍入远离零到分时,只看 0.001 位,丢弃更低位不影响结果;有 pin(`1.0049999…` → 壹元整,`1.005000…` → 壹元零壹分)。小于 0.001 的金额写零元整,带符号的情形也是。`formulas.mdx` 采纳了上一轮的非阻塞建议,写明 formula 字段把这个错误读作 `null`。

**R1 · 舍入后才达到 10^16 的金额不再被拒,会写成「亿亿」。** 旧 head 在舍入**之后**判断 `abs >= LIMIT_FEN`(10^18 分)。新 head 只在舍入**之前**按首位数字的位次判断(`place > TOP_PLACE`)。拿 `'9999999999999999.995'` 逐步读代码:
- 首位数字的 `place = 15`,不大于 `TOP_PLACE`,放行;
- `kept = '9999999999999999995'`,`divideToPlaces(…, 2)` 半舍入远离零,得 `fen = 10^18`;
- `whole = 10^16`,`yuan(10^16)` 走两次 `≥ 1e8` 分支,得 `壹亿亿`;
- 返回 `壹亿亿元整`。

这正是 pin 标题「10^16 yuan and above is refused, not written as 亿亿」要排除的写法,而且 changeset 和 docs 都说这个量级是运行时错误。负数 `'-9999999999999999.995'` 同理,会写成 `负壹亿亿元整`。新增的 pin 没有覆盖这个边界:`9999999999999999.99` 和 `9.999999999999999e15` 都不进位。

请在 `spelledFen` 返回之前(或在 `rmbUpper` 里)补回舍入之后的上限判断(`|fen| >= 10^18` ⇒ `TOO_LARGE`),并为 `'9999999999999999.995'` 与 `'-9999999999999999.995'` 各加一条拒收 pin;`'9999999999999999.994'` 作为 CONTROL,应写成玖仟…玖拾玖元玖角玖分。

### ① Derived judgments

- S1 is closed. `rmbUpper` now judges the spelling of its argument before converting it: the out-of-range class is refused (too large) or read as zero (below the rounding place) before the work, and the work is bounded by the length of the text. Evaluated at this head over the class and its variant spellings (sign, case, zero prefixes, very long digit runs with and without a point, malformed tails): every one answered promptly with the right result. Right.
- Accept-set is unchanged: the same spellings are read and the same are refused as at `4fffca7e` (surrounding whitespace read; `_`, a bare sign, a bare point, a dangling exponent refused). Right.
- Values: the side-by-side run found one input class whose result changed — M1 below. Every other compared input, including all the earlier record's ① known answers, is identical. Truncating at the 0.001 place before rounding is sound for half-away-from-zero at 分 and showed no difference on either sign.
- M1 (must-fix) — `packages/formula/src/rmb-upper.ts`, `spelledFen`: the upper bound is now judged on the leading digit of the unrounded spelling only, so text in [9999999999999999.995, 10^16) passes it, rounds to 10^16 yuan, and is printed as `壹亿亿元整` (`负壹亿亿元整` when negative). At `4fffca7e` these threw the too-large error. This is the form the file's own `TOP_PLACE` comment says is refused, it breaks `yuan()`'s "below 10^16" precondition, and it makes the docblock's "largest amount written is … 99 分" false. Text only; a JS number cannot carry it. Required change: refuse when the rounded 分 value reaches 10^18 as well (the check the previous head had after rounding), and pin `'9999999999999999.995'` as too large beside the existing `'9999999999999999.99'` control. No existing or new pin covers this row, which is why the suite is green.
